answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 156376 Country: India Title: While reciting Quran Azan is recited. Are we supposed to stop reciting Quran and hear Azan or we can continue reciting Quran? Question: While reciting Quran Azan is recited. Are we supposed to stop reciting Quran and hear Azan or we can continue reciting Quran? Answer ID: 156376 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 257/282/L=3/1439) If you are reciting the Holy Quran in the mosque at the time of Azan then it is allowed to continue and in case you are at your home then you should stop the recitation and reply Azan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
